ns2:course.label: Veterinary Clinical Medicine
ns2:course.description: (V C M 394) To be used to designate a trial or experimental course for five or more students, designed to be an elective in the CVM professional curriculum. The course can be taught under this designation for two years or two offerings, whichever time is greater. May be repeated to a maximum of 6 hours. 1 to 3 graduate or professional hours. Approved for S/U grading only. Prerequisite: Registration in the veterinary curriculum or consent of instructor.
